items.title: CoStar Group (CSGP) Sees US Industrial Demand Outpacing Supply By Late 2027
items.summary: CoStar Group (NasdaqGS: CSGP) issued a revised forecast that U.S. industrial real estate demand could outpace new supply by late 2027. The updated outlook points to a potential turning point in industrial market fundamentals that may affect leasing, development and capital allocation decisions. Sector investors and developers are watching the forecast closely as they reassess pipeline projects and portfolio exposure in light of the projected shift.
